title: Siren of the Seas
poem: Once she found a pair of twins in the sky.
They ran, and I never found out why.
I hear they live today, running about doing void knows what.
comment: You want to hear about her? Alright.

title: I'm irrelevant.
poem: a little moth singing about me.
Fly in the skies and a visage may show.
But who you would see you shall never know.
comment: You want to hear about me?

title: Terra, though she was something less at first
poem: A monster, both pitied and bound.
Claim the Earth and the sky will fall
Claim the Earth and the sea shall maul
I remember her father. He thought,
Look how that ended for us all.
comment: Ah, a story long past my time. But no-one else has claimed this role yet, so we will tell it:

title: A Forest Cloaked in Death
poem: Would also blame their gods for inaction,
So they looked to Fear for everything,
While the aid of Hope sat behind a question,
While the end and destruction lay behind a suggestion
comment: What is there to say? We cannot fight a plague alone. We could not fight anything but ourselves.

title: The Land of Butterflies
poem: Someone wrote about this for homework.

title: Sand of Void and Sea of Sorrow
poem: Have you heard of the Void?
Who would live with Death to escape it-
Even Nothing would resent your vice.
comment: I heard: an automaton lies suspended in the Palace to this day. It has become the highest Abyss.

title: Risen From Ashes and Fated to Burn
poem: I think our friend found it from a haiku
And yet another shall take the blame.
comment: Ah, such a short-lived dream. Or perhaps it was a nightmare; you can decide.

title: Not a Very Nice Neighbor at All.
poem: And the ones standing at your side?
Of course you did; young fool.
comment: Well, hubris *is* the end of us all.

title: Below Where Many Gods Fight
poem: I remember the ones who fought,
Their faces and the time they bought
But I had long been gone,
And a Wyrm came bearing a song.
comment: Ah, another recent story. I think, this one becomes quite important.
